name: Ukud Necropolis
description: A temple built in the time of the khans to house Sultai nobility, now the resting place of Silumgar's high-ranking dragons and a treasure vault.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1

timeline.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai begin raiding the Ukud Necropolis vaults.
timeline.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai began raiding its vaults.
